title: Atlas Edit Proposal — 2026-05-18
body:
On behalf of @atlas-axis, we are submitting the Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle proposal below.

This proposal includes the following edits:

- **Define Executive Process Liaison And Strategic Team Roles** — Adds definitional documents for the Executive Process Liaison and Strategic Team, and adds Prime Agents to the Roles in the Executive Process Section.
- **Rebrand Launch Agent 6 To Osero** — Now that Launch Agent 6 has come out of stealth, its name is updated to Osero across the Atlas.
- **Fix Stale Cross-Reference Labels And Naming Inconsistencies** — Updates stale cross-reference labels to the canonical short format, normalizes curly quotes and apostrophes in cross-references, and fixes a title-case inconsistency in Ecosystem Accord 7.
author: adamgfraser
